notes.title: Coming Soon
notes.content:
There are some pretty stupid things to cover here:

This game is a re-release of one of my games that I’m trying to remove from sale called Kuudere Funk. The game had sexual content in it and I’m just not willing to sell nor make pornographic games anymore. So, I decided to re-release the game under a new appID while providing owners of Kuudere Funk access to this re-release.

My reasons for doing it like this instead of an update is so that I wouldn’t be revoking access to the erotic version of the game to people who payed money for that content while preventing any further sales of it and to hide any community posts (reviews, screenshots, etc.) referring to any of the sexual content. I’m not trying to run some kind of scam and getting all of those community posts to not refer to the sexual content just isn’t realistically possible.

So, here are the patch notes for this transition:

Some backgrounds/tilesets were recolored
It’s now possible to dash through enemies when dashing at them within a close range
Some minor changes to the dialogue
Removal of sexual content
